result.summary: The page is largely intact. Excluding the intentional edge-clipped carousel and category chip and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, the only notable defect is a blank profile control in the header.

issues.description: The circular profile control in the top-right header is an empty pale circle with no photo, initials, or icon, so the small red notification dot appears to float on a blank shape that blends into the white background.
issues.suggestion: Show a user avatar, initials, or a default profile icon inside the circle and give the circle a visible border or background so the notification badge is anchored to a recognizable control.
